items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Harrison Barnes told me, I mean Harrison Brasley, told me he's supposed to make those records but he couldn't do it.

ctx.x: I made a recording with Rainey. Mm-hmm. Kid Rainey. That's the next recording. What recording else I made after that?
You know Harrison Barnes told me, I mean Harrison Brasley, told me he's supposed to make those records but he couldn't do it.
And I made a recording, I made a recording with, with, uh, with, uh, Kid Howard, Peter Bucca, Rudy Blush.
